{{Youmay|The aristocratic Houses|a different [[Triad (disambiguation)]]}}
The '''Triad''' was a name by which the three dominant [[Great House]]s of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]]; [[House Juoni]], [[House Praji/Legends|House Praji]] and [[House Vahali/Legends|House Vahali]]; were collectively known. The Triad possessed great influence on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Tinker">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref>
